post.description:
Server-to-server, called by PayPal. NO signature verification is performed (the HMAC verifier is commented out), so anyone who can reach the URL can post events. Body is parsed as free-form JSON; only the fields in PayPalWebhookEvent are read. The handler checks, in order: `resource` present, `resource.id` string present, `event_type` present, then dispatches:

- CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED: captures the order through the PayPal API using resource.id. Does NOT change the transaction status; the later PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED does. Invalidates the buyer's profile cache when the invoice ID resolves.
- PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED: sets the transaction (invoice ID) to status 1 → trigger credits points; invalidates the profile cache.
- CHECKOUT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED: same branch, but its status mapping is 0, so it updates Pending→Pending (no effect).
- PAYMENT.CAPTURE.DENIED / PAYMENT.CAPTURE.DECLINED: sets status 2; update failures are only logged.
- anything else: acknowledged, not processed.

The transaction UUID (invoice ID) is read from resource.invoice_id, else resource.purchase_units[0].invoice_id, else resource.custom. Status updates only apply to Pending (0) rows; a repeat delivery after settlement fails the update and returns 500 for the COMPLETED branch.

200.description: Processed or acknowledged. message is one of 'Webhook processed successfully', 'Capture successful', 'Payment declined webhook received', 'Webhook received, but not processed'.

400.description: Missing resource / resource.id / event_type, missing invoice ID on a COMPLETED event, or an invoice ID that is not a UUID. Malformed JSON returns actix plain text.

415.description: Content-Type is not application/json (actix JSON extractor).

500.description: Status update failed on a COMPLETED event (including the transaction is no longer Pending), or the PayPal capture call failed. PayPal retries non-2xx deliveries.

post.description:
Server-to-server, called by PayMongo. NO signature verification (PayMongo-Signature check is commented out). The raw body is read as UTF-8 and parsed as PayMongoWebhookPayload. Event type = data.attributes.type:

- payment.paid: sets the transaction to status 1 → trigger credits points.
- payment.failed: sets the transaction to status 2.
- anything else: ignored.

The transaction UUID is data.attributes.data.attributes.metadata.transaction_id (copied by PayMongo from the checkout session metadata set at purchase). The handler ALWAYS answers 200 text/plain 'Webhook received and processed' once the payload parses — including unknown events, a missing transaction_id, and failed status updates — so PayMongo never retries those. The buyer's profile cache is NOT invalidated here (unlike PayPal).

200.description: Always this body once the payload parses, whatever happened afterwards.

400.description: Body is not UTF-8 ('Invalid UTF-8 payload'), does not match PayMongoWebhookPayload ('Invalid payload format'), inner attributes lack `metadata` ('Error processing payment.paid event' / 'Error processing payment.failed event') — all text/plain — or metadata.transaction_id is not a UUID (JSON, note the trailing space in the message).

PayPalWebhookEvent.description: PayPal webhook event. Only the listed fields are read; everything else PayPal sends is ignored.

event_type.description: CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED, PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED, CHECKOUT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED, PAYMENT.CAPTURE.DENIED, PAYMENT.CAPTURE.DECLINED are handled; others are acknowledged.

id.description: Order ID (order events) or capture ID (capture events). Used for the capture call on CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED.

invoice_id.description: Capture events: our WebTransaction.transaction_id. Checked first.

purchase_units.description: Order events: purchase_units[0].invoice_id is checked second.

type.description: Rust field object_type, renamed to "type". Normally "event".
Rust field event_type, renamed to "type". payment.paid and payment.failed are handled.

PaymentDataAttributes.x-rust-type: PaymentDataAttributes (deserialized from serde_json::Value for handled events only)
PaymentDataAttributes.description: Only `metadata` is read. Its Rust type is serde_json::Value (not Option), so the key must be present for handled events.

transaction_id.description: WebTransaction.transaction_id, set by POST /transaction/{id} when it created the checkout session.
